properties.name: The memory boundary is settled into three places, and the rule that says so is delivered at the step
properties.rationale: Anthony 2026-09-19: 'Promote your recommended fix.' Options (a) and (b) of the brainstorm; (c) dropped because reflow2 cannot see an agent's memory directory and should not learn to; (d) kept as the unbuilt local check; (e) dropped as the status quo that produced the problem.
properties.summary: The rule's operative sentence now names ENCODE / GRAPH / MEMORY and sits inside the 600 characters a served lesson carries; the rule gained `steps` (capture-session, root-cause, triage-feedback, record_finding, add_design_rule); the dated ruling, its measured basis, its stated limit and one withdrawn counter-argument were appended with replace_text rather than a full-field rewrite.
